Name: Mx. Qi
Author: Isilily
Description:
Gender binary got you down? Now you can eschew that silly gendered prefix in Mr. Qi's name by making him Mx. Qi! It may not roll off the tongue as well, but who says mysterious casino owners need to follow the gender binary?

[b][u]Installation:
[/u][/b]-Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]﻿
-Unzip into the Mods folder
-Run the game with SMAPI

Let me know if you find anywhere his prefix hasn't been changed. Thanks for downloading!

Hateful/bad faith comments will be deleted. :)

Manifest.Name: Mx. Qi
Manifest.Description: Changes Mr. Qi's prefix to the gender neutral Mx.
